rust_summary: a content mod's whole content before the resources are built (`native_content`): code declares blocks and items as files would (`Content::declare_block`, `declare_item`).
doc_summary: `native_content(content)` gets each enabled content mod's content (`horizon_mods::Content`) before its blocks one by one (`native_content_block`) and before the game builds its resources, at startup and on each resource reload, on the thread that builds the resource root. A mod whose code registers its blocks and items declares them there with `content.declare_block(id, json)` and `content.declare_item(id, json)`: the JSON is what a file `data/<mod id>/horizon/block/<path>.json` (or `item/`) would hold, checked the same way, and replaces a declaration of the same id ([mods.md](mods.md)). Bundles need "hooks": @API:content@.
